notes.title: Freed from the Obsidian Shards
notes.notes:
Hi Adventurers,

After due consideration, I have decided to keep Shattering Obsidian on Steam. Once arranged
with the Steamworks staff, the initial release will be free.

If I, one day, get back to it and create future chapters, the pricing may change, but all who own the initial release will be able to access any future additions.

Thanks for your patience,

James

notes.title: Shattered Obsidian
notes.notes:
To all the wonderful players that explored the world of the Obsidian Tower and beyond, I will be removing this game from Steam. I did have wonderful stories planned for future chapters, as free updates, but the project fell apart due to hardware failure and lost data.

I will not be able to continue, although some of the ideas will appear in a new, upcoming project,


I thank those who went on a little journey in a strange land, no matter how brief...
